name: Alexandria
tagline: Egypt's Mediterranean city of Cleopatra and the great library
summary: Founded by Alexander the Great, Alexandria was the ancient world's centre of learning. Today it's a breezy Mediterranean city of corniche cafés, the modern Bibliotheca Alexandrina, a fort on the site of the Pharos lighthouse and Roman catacombs.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are mild. Summer is crowded with Egyptian holidaymakers. Winter is cool, rainy and stormy.
arrival: Trains from Cairo take about 2.5 hours. Borg El Arab Airport is about an hour away.
gettingAround: Old trams, taxis and Careem along the corniche.
cashTip: Keep small Egyptian pound notes for tips, taxis and markets; major sites take cards. Agree prices before rides.
foodTip: Fresh fish by weight, Alexandrian liver sandwiches and feteer.
buyTip: Antiques and old books near Attarin.
baseArea: Along the corniche near Raml Station
